zh: augmented PAKE：仅一方知道口令的 PAKE 变体。
strong shared key：由协议导出的会话密钥。
prime-order group：协议可适配的群类型。
Independent Submission：RFC Editor 独立投稿流。
password file：验证方保存的口令派生记录。
en: Augmented PAKE: the variant where only one party knows the password.
Strong shared key: the session key the protocol derives.
Prime-order group: the group class the protocol fits.
Independent Submission: the RFC Editor stream it appeared in.
Password file: the verifier’s stored password-derived record.
